subcategory_text: Adequate capacity to ensure availability is maintained.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-2 (Contingency Plan), AU-4 (Audit Storage Capacity), SC-5 (Denial of Service Protection)
implementation_examples: Maintain adequate capacity for personal-data systems to ensure availability within defined targets, with monitoring and capacity-planning processes
Use telemetry and SLOs to detect capacity pressure
Refresh capacity plans on changes in data volume or service adoption
assessment_objectives: Determine whether capacity is monitored against availability targets
Determine whether capacity planning is documented and refreshed on change
Determine whether capacity exhausts are detected and acted on
Determine whether contingency capacity exists for adverse conditions
